facts.fact: The New Times reports that the law governing registration into the Single Digital ID (SDID) system sets a June 2027 deadline after which existing national identity cards are no longer valid; the article does not give the law's number or kind of instrument, and the date is the article's published date.
facts.system: Law governing registration into the Single Digital ID system

facts.fact: The article describes the system under the law governing registration into the Single Digital ID as built on a unique Single Digital Identification Number, a derived token and a QR-code card, with authentication relying on biometric data; date is the article's published date.
facts.system: Law governing registration into the Single Digital ID system
